description: This bar chart illustrates negative log probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between a baseline model, Mistral-v0.2, and the same model fine-tuned on various specialty datasets. The horizontal axis represents per-specialty terms, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and displays a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1. For each specialty, there are multiple bars representing the negative log probability for the baseline model and fine-tuned versions; these bars are visually distinguished by color, with the baseline model represented in light blue, Cardio in pale orange, Gastro in a slightly darker orange, Infect in medium orange, Neuro in dark orange, Obstetrics in a reddish-brown, and Pediatrics in a darker reddish-brown. Within each specialty grouping, the bars are arranged adjacent to one another. The height of the bars varies; for example, within the "Cardio" specialty grouping, the light blue bar extends to approximately -22.5, while the darker orange bar is approximately -26.5. The bars do not appear to be sorted within each specialty grouping, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
